The increasing availability of high-resolution UAV data, quantitative studies on landform changes using DEMs have
become a viable option.

UAV data were acquired over the Puthumala landslide in Kerala area on 22 March 2021. The resolution of
orthoimage of UAV is 2 cm and the grid size of DTM is 8 cm. The positional accuracy of the image is 1-2 m. . Pre and
post-DEM were utilized forvolumetric estimation and release area mapping.
